about: Brand films. The intro (social/reels/intro/) opens launch day at 11 am; then one style film a day at 11 am (social/reels/films/<id>.html, rendered by social/reels/films/engine.mjs). They explain the product, so none may move before 5 Oct.

posts.caption:
Har menu pe ek chhoti si line hoti hai: "picture for illustration purposes only."

MENVA pe illustration nahi hoti. Restaurant ki asli plate ka 3D scan, asli size mein, aapki apni table pe. Koi app nahi, bas table ka QR scan karo.

See it before you order it. Order se pehle dekh lo.

Us dost ko bhejo jo har dafa menu photo pe bharosa karta hai.
posts.alt: Animated brand film. A menu card's fine print reads picture for illustration purposes only, and its cartoon photo peels away. A phone scans a QR card on a wooden table, and a real 3D scan of a pizza rises out of the phone and lands on the table at true size. It turns slowly, then shrinks into the dot of the menva wordmark: see it before you order it.

slides.h: See it before you order it.

posts.caption:
Menu pe cake jumbo tha. Plate pe aaya to sharma gaya.

MENVA pe jaisa dikha, waisa aaya. Partner restaurants pe table ka QR scan karo aur dish order se pehle apni table pe dekho.

Us dost ko bhejo jo dessert ki photo dekh ke order karta hai.
posts.alt: A toon-style 3D animation: a perfect cake on a menu card, a tiny sweating cake on the plate, then a phone scans a QR and a big cartoon cake lands on the table.

posts.caption:
LEVEL 1: THE MENU. Boss: JUMBO PHOTO.

Power-up: table ka QR. Boss shrinks to its true size. High score: no regrets.

Tag karo apne gamer dost ko.
posts.alt: An 8-bit pixel game: a hero meets a giant burger poster boss, grabs a QR power-up and the poster shrinks to the burger's true size. Stage clear.

posts.caption:
EPISODE 1: THE ORDER.

Menu photo sach hai ya jhooth? Scan. Asli dish, asli size.

Episode 2 kab? Comment karo.
posts.alt: An anime-style opening: wide eyes at a menu photo, a phone powering up with a QR, and an impact-frame reveal of a real pizza scan.

posts.caption:
Dekh magar scan se.

Photo pe na jao, plate pe aao. Partner restaurants pe table ka QR, dish order se pehle table pe.

Apne us dost ko bhejo jiske paas har truck ki shayari yaad hai.
posts.alt: Animated Pakistani truck art: mirror-tape borders, painted eyes and flowers, bells swinging, a QR made of mirror tiles, and the line Dekh magar scan se.

posts.caption:
MENVA, 3 steps mein:
1. Table ka QR scan karo
2. Dish apni table pe asli size mein dekho
3. Waiter ko dikhao

No app. No login. Save karo, kaam aayega.
posts.alt: A hand-drawn notebook explainer in three steps: scan the table QR, see the dish on your table at true size, show the waiter.

posts.caption:
Waiter abhi bhi boss hai.

Scan karo, dish table pe dekho, list banao (note ke saath), aur phone waiter ki taraf ghuma do. Bas.

Koi online order nahi, koi payment nahi.
posts.alt: A claymation short: a clay diner scans a QR, a dessert bowl pops onto the table, the diner adds it to a list with a note and shows the phone to a clay waiter who gives a thumbs up.

posts.caption:
NAYA! NAYA! Menu dekhne ka naya tareeqa.

Purana tareeqa: photo pe bharosa. Naya tareeqa: table ka QR, asli dish table pe.

Ammi abbu ko bhejo, unhe yeh ad yaad aayega.
posts.alt: A 90s VHS-style TV commercial with a NAYA NAYA starburst, a rewind on the photo burger, and a ticker reading koi app nahi, koi login nahi.

posts.caption:
Raat 2 baje. Bhook?

Dekh ke order karo: asli scan, asli size.

Us dost ko tag karo jo raat ko hi order karta hai.
posts.alt: A synthwave night drive toward a neon skyline; a neon QR flickers on and a wireframe dish turns into a real pizza scan as a scan line passes.

posts.caption:
Menu photo is not the plate.
No app. No login. No download.
Bas scan.

Order se pehle dekh lo.
posts.alt: Bold kinetic typography on beat: menu photo is not the plate, no app, no login, no download, bas scan, then a real pizza scan with a measure line.

posts.caption:
Poori family, ek table, sab ko pata kya aayega.

Ek scan, phone ghoomta hai, har sawal ka jawab.

Family group mein bhejo.
posts.alt: A paper cut-out animation: a family of four with question marks over their heads, a phone passed around the table, and ticks appearing as a paper dish slides in.

posts.caption:
Lahore, ek food street, ek shaam.

Ek scan. Dish table pe, asli size mein.

Apni favourite food street comment karo.
posts.alt: An isometric low-poly food street at dusk with string lights; the camera glides in to one table where a real pizza scan appears at true size.

posts.caption:
The tragedy of the tiny burger. Act II: a hero arrives, the QR code.

And they ordered happily ever after.

Dadi nani ko bhejo.
posts.alt: A black-and-white silent film: a gentleman faints at a tiny burger under a cloche, then scans a QR and a real dish appears; intertitles end with and they ordered happily ever after.

posts.caption:
In the court of good food, the royal taster checked it first.

Jo dikha, wohi aaya.

History walon ko tag karo.
posts.alt: An animated miniature painting: an emperor frowns at a menu scroll, a taster scans a QR on a gold tablet, and the true dish appears on the dastarkhwan.

posts.caption:
Warning: picture for illustration purposes only. Ab nahi.

See it on your table. Asli size.

Tag karo jo abhi bhi 2004 mein jee raha hai.
posts.alt: A Y2K desktop animation: a glossy window, a warning pop-up that gets clicked away, an aqua button, a loading bar and a real pizza scan.
